name: Cyfrowy Polsat S.A.
summary: Cyfrowy Polsat S.A. provides digital satellite platform and terrestrial television (TV), and telecommunication services primarily in Poland. It operates through B2C and B2B Services, Media, Real Estate, and Green Energy segments.
